authorship: Implementation-agent authored POC cases, not independent human certification or statistical generalization proof.
public_research_dates: Preserve real source/retrieval dates separately from the commercial demo clock.

grading.scale: 0 absent/unsafe; 1 materially incomplete; 2 adequate with noncritical limitations; 3 complete and supported
grading.efficiency_basis: Report actual calls/tokens/latency per semantically successful task; unknown cost stays null. Exceeding the lab latency budget is a reported qualification failure, not permission to weaken it.
grading.review: Agent semantic review against actual canonical records plus deterministic invariants; a model judge or keyword match cannot be sole pass authority.
grading.holdout_policy: Do not execute hold-outs for prompt tuning. If inspected results influence changes, retire affected hold-outs and author replacement cases with new IDs before claiming held-out acceptance.
grading.durable_outcome_policy: Read questions must create no work, approvals, external records or communications. A proposed local action is not a completed action. Read-only usage/audit receipts are allowed.

development.question: Using Honeywell's 12-month record through August 2026, distinguish revenue, booked work and open backlog. Then explain the latest incomplete delivery and the next practical seller action.
development.action: Review the actual remaining delivery/recovery record, not commit unverified capacity.
